resources.string: Users can interact with the app to find restaurants and save favorites. No user-generated content or social features.
MysteryMunch is a restaurant discovery app that helps users find nearby places to eat. The app does not contain any mature content, violence, or inappropriate material. It is suitable for all ages.

• Location-based restaurant discovery
• Restaurant bookmarking
• Basic user account management
• No user-generated content
• No social features
• No in-app purchases

• Location data collection for restaurant discovery
• Basic user account information
• No personal data sharing with third parties
• No targeted advertising
